finding: Change in four related women’s empowerment indicators
supporting_evidence: Literacy +6.5 pp; schooling +6.3 pp; clean fuel +15.9 pp; marriage before 18 −3.8 pp across 555 district matches
contradicting_evidence: Bank-account-use and mobile-use indicators are unavailable in both factsheets; changes do not establish any financial access mechanism

finding: Account ownership may not equal active independent use
supporting_evidence: NFHS wording measures women who have and themselves use an account; programme materials describe access infrastructure
contradicting_evidence: No reviewed passage directly measures independent use; field validation required

finding: Connectivity and local delivery shape service access
supporting_evidence: PMJDY brochure, p. 30, notes unreliable telecom in some tribal/hilly locations
contradicting_evidence: Document is a national mission design source, not a district outcome evaluation
